summary: LEFT BEHIND – Stories Beyond Earth is an educational website that brings forgotten space exploration machines back to life through interactive storytelling. The project explores the equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars, introducing their missions, discoveries and contributions to space science. It features fictional character conversations, an interactive mission timeline, simplified scientific explanations and knowledge quizzes to make learning more engaging.The main challenge addressed by this project is that space exploration history and scientific information can sometimes be difficult for students to understand or find interesting. LEFT BEHIND tackles this by transforming complex information into simple explanations and storytelling experiences. By combining education with interactive features, the project helps users develop a better understanding of space exploration, appreciate the technology behind important discoveries and recognise the contributions of machines that helped humanity explore beyond Earth.
details: Left Behind personalise space equipments left behind by NASA on the moon and mars for school-aged space enthusiast to learn about them. The website allows the equipments to tell their stories of their journey on the Moon and Mars through interactive storytelling. It introduces school-aged space enthusiast to the equipments by understanding the stories and science behind the equipments by doing the quiz. We used Chatgpt, Acode, GitHub, and Gemini to help us develop this website. The equipments can tell its own stories by voiced dialogues. We considered the creativity of our project, we want to make it more understandable for school-aged space enthusiasts.
